keyword: are we going to the moon

verifications.claim: NASA has officially launched the Artemis II mission as of April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: The Artemis II crew blasted off on their lunar journey from Kennedy Space Center in Florida on Wednesday (R2); Artemis II mission lifted off from Kennedy Space Center in Cape Canaveral, Florida, ... on April 1 (R4); The Space Launch System rocket and Orion spacecraft ... lifted off from Kennedy Space Center in Florida at 6:35 p.m. ET (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the launch date as April 1, 2026.

verifications.claim: Artemis II sends four astronauts on a 10-day trip around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: The flight ... is taking ... four astronauts ... on what is expected to be a round trip of more than 695,000 miles (R2); sending astronauts on a 10-day voyage around the Moon and back (R4); 10-day mission (R6, R8, R9, R10, R11)
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently describe four astronauts on a 10-day mission around the Moon.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: first crewed moon mission since 1972 (R5); humanity’s first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years (R4); more than 50 years ago (R2); first crewed flight around the moon in more than 50 years (R6)
verifications.reasoning: All sources agree it is the first crewed lunar mission since Apollo 17 in 1972, over 50 years.

verifications.claim: Artemis II acts as a precursor to landing astronauts including the first woman on the Moon's surface in 2028.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: Artemis II, the first crewed Artemis flight, marks a key step toward long-term return to the Moon (R1); clear a path for ... a new lunar landing (R2); foster a sustained lunar program ... first landing attempt ... in 2025 ... crew will include ... a woman (R3); in preparation for future missions ... land astronauts on the Moon with Artemis IV in 2028 (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm Artemis II as precursor to landings, Artemis aims for first woman/POC on Moon, targeting 2028 landing (Artemis IV), but no direct statement tying first woman landing specifically to 2028.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew consists of Reid Wiseman, Christina Koch, Victor Glover, and Jeremy Hansen.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch and Jeremy Hansen (R2); Reid Wiseman, Christina Koch, Victor Glover, and Jeremy Hansen (R4, R6, R10, R11)
verifications.reasoning: Exact crew names listed in multiple sources.
